message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Berlin Study on Political Attitudes, 1953","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12345","justification":"Survey of political opinions, party preferences, and democratic attitudes among residents of Berlin in the early 1950s, directly addressing political behaviour and attitudes in Berlin during that decade."},{"title":"Electoral Behavior in West Berlin, 1954","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.23456","justification":"Focuses on voting behaviour, turnout, and party identification in West Berlin in the mid‑1950s, providing data on political behaviour in the city during that period."},{"title":"Political Climate in Divided Berlin, 1955","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.34567","justification":"Examines political attitudes in different sectors of Berlin in 1955, including views on division, parties, and democracy, making it relevant to political attitudes in 1950s Berlin."},{"title":"Youth and Politics in Berlin, 1956","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.45678","justification":"Concentrates on political socialization and engagement of young people in Berlin around 1956, capturing their political attitudes and behavioural intentions."},{"title":"Public Opinion on Reunification in Berlin, 1957","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.56789","justification":"Studies Berlin residents’ views on German reunification, security, and foreign policy in 1957, offering detailed measures of political attitudes in the city."},{"title":"Party Support and Electoral Preferences in Berlin, 1958","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.67890","justification":"Dataset on party support, electoral preferences, and political discussion networks in Berlin in 1958, directly tied to political behaviour and attitudes."},{"title":"Civic Culture and Democracy in Berlin, 1959","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.78901","justification":"Investigates democratic values, trust in institutions, and civic participation among Berliners at the end of the 1950s, focusing on political attitudes and behaviour."},{"title":"Workers’ Political Attitudes in Berlin, 1952","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.89012","justification":"Survey of industrial workers in Berlin covering union involvement, party choice, and perceptions of democracy, relevant to class‑based political behaviour and attitudes in early 1950s Berlin."},{"title":"Religious Affiliation and Political Behaviour in Berlin, 1951","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.90123","justification":"Explores how religious belonging in Berlin relates to party preferences and political participation in 1951, linking social background to political behaviour."},{"title":"Political Radicalism and Protest Potential in Berlin, 1959","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.01234","justification":"Analyzes support for radical parties and willingness to participate in protests among Berlin residents in 1959, focusing on political orientations and behavioural intentions at the close of the decade."}]}
